Name: Beardless Wizard Sprite for Romanceable Rasmodius
Author: agent56
Description:
A custom Wizard sprite for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romanceable Rasmodius[/url] based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3759]Gigi's[/url] beardless wizard portrait

[b]﻿[u]Installation[/u][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073?tab=files]Romanceable Rasmodius[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7000]the SVE version[/url]﻿ (and prereqs)
[*]﻿Open the config.json and set "Sprite" to "custom"
[*]Install this
[/list]
[u][b]Incompatibility[/b]
[/u]This mod won't play nice with any other mods that replace the Wizard's sprite

[u][b]Recommended Mods:
[/b][/u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3759]Gigi's Hi-Res Portraits mod[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15017]Gigi's Beardless Wizard for Romanceable Rasmodius[/url]

Manifest.Name: Beardless Wizard for Romanceable Rasmodius
Manifest.Description: Changes the Wizard sprite to better match Gigi's beardless wizard.
Manifest.Author: AngelicCharizard
